_comment: Candidate profile for Mercedes-Benz Tech Innovation (Workday) applications. 3_MERCEDES_job_apply.py loads this file automatically at startup - if present, its values OVERRIDE the built-in constants in the script. Edit here, never in the source. Date fields are [month, day, year] strings. Source field: 'Job Portals' is a category that drills down; source_option must be one of its verified leaf children (Agentur fuer Arbeit, Google for Jobs, herCareer, Indeed, Mercedes-Benz career portal, Stepstone). No 'Career Fair' option exists in the live picker.
work_permit_option: Yes, I have a work and residence permit for Germany, but I am not a citizen of a member state of the EU/Iceland/Liechtenstein/Norway/Switzerland
data_transfer_option: Yes, I agree to the transfer of my data within Mercedes-Benz Tech Innovation and thus have the greatest possible chance of finding a suitable position for me.
